about_the_game:
Take to the stars with the Interstellar Map Pack! This pack is centered around the dangers, adventures, and journeys of journeying across the stars.

Survive a crash landing on a marsh planet with Marsh Crash, visit an urban planet with Planetopolis, work your way around the solar system with The Habitable Zone, hop from planet to planet with Planet Hopping, cross the equator of a desert planet with Sandstone, or cross the spiral galaxy with Journey Quest’s largest map ever in Galaxy Crossing.

Unlocking this pack enables you to host games for all players of Journey Quest, even those who have not unlocked the pack themselves.
